status: pre-trial engineering assumptions; not measured printed-part allowables

PETG.reference_derivation: Published interlayer adhesion 18 +/- 4 MPa; 14 is a screening value, not a statistical lower confidence bound.
PETG.constitutive_model: isotropic linear elastic compliance screen; weakest reported adhesion used for all principal directions and von Mises limit
limitations: No measured orthotropic stiffness matrix or compression/shear strength is available.
Using adhesion/2 for stress modes is an engineering screening rule, not a validated failure surface.
The 0.8 multiplier explores uncertainty; it is not a measured temperature law.
Creep, print defects and cyclic degradation are not certified by a static solve.
Build orientation and physical sample verification remain necessary.
